intro.en: Hello {first}, {screen} here. Your screening needs a follow-up visit at {site} on {date}. Dial {ussd} to confirm. Free service.
intro.sw: Habari {first}, ni {screen}. Uchunguzi wako unahitaji ziara ya ufuatiliaji {site} tarehe {date}. Piga {ussd} kuthibitisha. Bure.

reminder_low.en: Reminder: {first}, your follow-up visit at {site} is on {date}. Dial {ussd} to confirm or change the date.
reminder_low.sw: Kumbusho: {first}, miadi yako {site} ni tarehe {date}. Piga {ussd} kuthibitisha au kubadilisha tarehe.

reminder_medium.en: {first}, we are expecting you at {site} on {date}. This visit matters for your health. Dial {ussd} to confirm or reschedule.
reminder_medium.sw: {first}, tunakutarajia {site} tarehe {date}. Ziara hii ni muhimu kwa afya yako. Piga {ussd} kuthibitisha au kubadilisha.

reminder_high.en: {first}, your visit at {site} is on {date}. Fare is refunded by M-Pesa when you check in. {chp} will call you. Dial {ussd}.
reminder_high.sw: {first}, miadi yako {site} ni tarehe {date}. Utarudishiwa nauli kwa M-Pesa ukifika. {chp} atakupigia. Piga {ussd}.

confirmed.en: Thank you {first}. Your visit on {date} at {site} is confirmed. We will remind you the day before.
confirmed.sw: Asante {first}. Miadi yako ya tarehe {date} {site} imethibitishwa. Tutakukumbusha siku moja kabla.

rescheduled.en: {first}, your visit has been moved to {date} at {site}. Dial {ussd} if you need help.
rescheduled.sw: {first}, miadi yako imehamishwa hadi tarehe {date} {site}. Piga {ussd} ukihitaji msaada.

voucher.en: [SIMULATED M-PESA] {txn} Confirmed. You have received Ksh{amount}.00 from FUATILIA TRANSPORT on {date}. Karibu, {first}.
voucher.sw: [MFANO WA M-PESA] {txn} Imethibitishwa. Umepokea Ksh{amount}.00 kutoka FUATILIA USAFIRI tarehe {date}. Karibu, {first}.

treated.en: Thank you {first}. Your treatment is complete. Your next check is due around {date}. We will remind you.
treated.sw: Asante {first}. Matibabu yako yamekamilika. Kipimo chako kijacho ni karibu tarehe {date}. Tutakukumbusha.
